#1 (fix-19-shm-too-small) [LIKELY score=70/100] shared memory allowance too small for a serving workload
   id: fix-19-shm-too-small
   - 64.0 MiB is the whole shared-memory allowance, and a serving workload needs gigabytes
   - this is a docker container, whose default allowance is 64 MiB
   plan: Raise the shared-memory allowance before running the workload.
     $ # In a container: restart it with a larger allowance.
     $ #   docker run --shm-size=8g ...    # see fix-10-container
     $ # On a host: remount it, and make that survive a reboot.
     $ sudo mount -o remount,size=8g /dev/shm
     $ # /etc/fstab:  tmpfs  /dev/shm  tmpfs  defaults,size=8g  0 0
   flags: requires sudo, manual only (`rocm fix` will NOT run it automatically)
   note: A running container cannot have its allowance changed; it has to be started again.
   note: This is reported below 1.0 GiB. Silence is not proof of enough: a container given 2 GiB clears that bar and can still be too small for a large model.
   verify after fix: df -h /dev/shm
   apply with: rocm fix fix-19-shm-too-small

#2 (fix-10-container) [WEAK score=45/100] Container can't see /dev/kfd or /dev/dri/renderD*
   id: fix-10-container
   - running inside a docker
   - no /dev/dri/renderD* visible in the container
   plan: Re-launch the container with the AMD devices and the render group passed through.
     $ # Docker / Podman flags AMD-recommends:
     $ docker run --rm -it \
     $   --device=/dev/kfd \
     $   --device=/dev/dri \
     $   --group-add render \
     $   --security-opt seccomp=unconfined \
     $   --shm-size=8g \
     $   rocm/pytorch:latest
     $ # Rootless podman: also pass `--userns=keep-id` and ensure the
     $ # host user is in the render group; podman maps it through.
   flags: manual only (`rocm fix` will NOT run it automatically)
   note: Use rocm/pytorch or rocm/dev-ubuntu-22.04 as a known-good image. Mixing host ROCm + container ROCm versions is a separate footgun.
   verify after fix: rocminfo | head -n 5
   apply with: rocm fix fix-10-container

Highest-scoring match is below the HIGH_CONFIDENCE threshold. Confirm one more piece of evidence before applying.
When you are ready, run `rocm fix fix-19-shm-too-small` (the highest-scoring match), or use the `apply with:` line of whichever cause fits.
